name: qfim-bench
description: Re-release to register with Zenodo. Identical to v1.0.0; that release was published before Zenodo archiving was enabled for this repository, so it was not captured. Contents: Reproducible pipeline for Grover-based quantum frequent itemset mining (circuit construction, simulator and hardware backends, post-processing, and classical baselines). Generic characterization layer (statistics, noise comparison, repeated-run checks, scaling sweeps), usable with any Qiskit circuit. Archived hardware results from ibm_marrakesh, with predictions recorded before the runs. Automated test suite (53 passing, 1 skipped in a clean clone). Examples: quickstart, generic Bell-circuit demo, and a Streamlit dashboard. Apache-2.0 license. See CITATION.cff for how to cite this release.
